query: Raise the Tripo texture node's texture quality from 'standard' to 'detailed' and keep its PBR texturing enabled, so the rigged model's materials come through with finer detail in the final 3D preview.

desired.outcome: The Tripo texture node runs with texture quality set to 'detailed' and PBR texturing kept enabled, so the final rigged model shows finer material detail in the 3D preview.
desired.quality: Only the texture node's texture-quality widget changes ('standard' -> 'detailed'); conversion, refinement, rigging, retargeting, and preview stages stay connected and functional.

_tags.author_rationale: This query changes one COMBO widget on the existing Tripo texture node (texture_quality 'standard' -> 'detailed' with PBR kept enabled), so it is a specific low-abstraction edit rather than a structural component swap; the surrounding rigging and preview stages stay untouched.
